title: Sport, music and free time
intro: One thing to fix early: jugar takes a for a sport (jugar al fútbol), tocar is used for playing an instrument, and practicar covers taking part in a sport generally.

entries.note: jugar a with sports and games; never for instruments.

ex.en: We play football on Saturdays.

entries.en: to touch; to play (an instrument); to be someone's turn
entries.note: me toca a mí means it's my turn.

ex.en: Don't touch that, it's hot.
She plays the guitar very well.
Now it's your turn.
It's a card game.
She bought a set of plates.

ex.es: El partido empieza a las ocho.
ex.en: The match starts at eight.

ex.es: Ganó el partido de la oposición.
ex.en: The opposition party won.
Our team is bottom.
They brought the sound equipment.

entries.note: la pelota is any ball; el balón the large kind used in football.

ex.en: Pass me the ball.

entries.note: la piscina is the pool, la alberca in Mexico.

ex.en: He swims every morning.

entries.note: hacer ejercicio is to exercise; el gimnasio the gym.

ex.es: Hago ejercicio tres veces por semana.
ex.en: I exercise three times a week.

entries.note: empatar is to draw. See unit 17 for ganar meaning to earn.

ex.en: We won three to one.
They lost in the last minute.

entries.note: el músico is a musician; la canción a song; el cantante a singer.

ex.en: Put some music on while we cook.

entries.note: Plural canciones. cantar is to sing.

ex.es: Esa canción me recuerda a mi madre.
ex.en: That song reminds me of my mother.

entries.note: el baile is the dance; la danza the art form.

ex.en: I don't know how to dance salsa.

entries.note: el cine is the cinema, and also cinema as an art. la serie is a TV series.

ex.en: The film is three hours long.

entries.note: la novela is a novel. Don't confuse with la cuenta, the bill.

ex.es: Le leo un cuento cada noche.
ex.en: I read him a story every night.

entries.note: dibujar is to draw; los dibujos animados are cartoons.

ex.es: Colgamos sus dibujos en la cocina.
ex.en: We put her drawings up in the kitchen.

ex.es: La fiesta acabó a las tres.
ex.en: The party ended at three.
Monday is a public holiday.

entries.en: to have fun, to enjoy oneself
entries.note: ¡Diviértete! means have fun. divertido is fun as an adjective.

ex.es: Nos divertimos mucho en el viaje.
ex.en: We had a great time on the trip.

entries.note: dar un paseo is to go for a walk; pasear to stroll.

ex.es: Dimos un paseo por el centro.
ex.en: We went for a walk round the centre.
The painting is worth a lot.

ex.es: No tuvo el valor de decirlo.
ex.en: He didn't have the courage to say it.

entries.note: ganar un premio is to win a prize; el campeón the champion.

ex.en: She won first prize.
